parameters.content:
## SETUP (do this once)
1. Create 2 data tables (Data tables tab): **monitor_state** and **check_history**
2. Open each purple Data Table node and pick the matching table
3. Re-select the Gmail credential if asked
4. Activate the workflow

**monitor_state**: url, name, lastState, lastChangeAt, totalChecks, upChecks, incidents
**check_history**: url, checkedAt, state, statusCode, responseTimeMs

## Status change detection + history
Get Previous State reads the last state of the site from monitor_state. Status Tracker compares it with the current check. Save nodes update monitor_state and append a row to check_history. Mail is sent only when the state changed.

## Daily uptime report
Runs at 9 AM IST, reads both tables and emails per-site uptime (24h / all-time), avg and max response time, incidents.
